task.title: Install the Fence Agents Remediation Operator by using the web console
task.shortdesc: You can use the Red Hat OpenShift web console to install the Fence Agents Remediation Operator.

ul.li: Log in as a user with cluster-admin privileges.

step.cmd: In the Red Hat OpenShift web console, navigate to Ecosystem → Software Catalog.
Select the Fence Agents Remediation Operator, or FAR, from the list of available Operators, and then click Install.
Keep the default selection of Installation mode and namespace to ensure that the Operator is installed to the openshift-workload-availability namespace.

result.p: To confirm that the installation is successful:

ol.li: Navigate to the Operators → Installed Operators page.
Check that the Operator is installed in the openshift-workload-availability namespace and its status is Succeeded.

result.p: If the Operator is not installed successfully:

ol.li: Navigate to the Operators → Installed Operators page and inspect the Status column for any errors or failures.
Navigate to the Workloads → Pods page and check the log of the fence-agents-remediation-controller-manager pod for any reported issues.
